name: wickedchkn-platform
description: Direct ordering platform (clone of Wicked Chkn) — rebrand for a second restaurant. Customer PWA + admin dashboard + shared backend.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,customer,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w customer" "npm run dev -w admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w customer && npm run build -w admin
